source: NCEP Stage IV hourly precipitation analysis, IEM archive
conversion: GRIB tp/accum kg m**-2: 1 kg/m2 water = 1 mm; exactly one hour gives mm/h numerically
limitations: Historical Stage IV radar/gauge precipitation analysis, not measured rainfall at every cell or a calibrated flood prediction.
Nearest native roughly 4 km cells mapped onto a padded 0.01 degree forcing grid; finer output spacing adds no rainfall detail.
No missing-value fill, no fitted rescaling, and no blending with obsolete IEM PNG products.
Hourly constant rates omit subhour variability. This forcing does not supply upstream river inflow or downstream hydraulic boundaries.
historicalProductEvidence: NCAR archive documents Stage IV from January 2002 and GRIB1 through July 2020; files decoded here carry their own September 2014 validity times.
